To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) an ensemble of fine-tuning CNN architectures achieves a higher accuracy on a benchmark medical image classification dataset than established CNN methods; and 2) the ensemble is only outperformed by methods that source additional medical image training data.
an ensemble of fine-tuning convolutional neural networks achieves a state-of-the art accuracy for medical image classification.

(a) an ensemble of fine-tuning different CNN architectures is more accurate than using a single CNN, (b) the fine-tuning approach is more accurate than the standard training approach, (c) the ensemble of fine-tunned CNNs is more accurate than established CNNs, (d) our ensemble achieves a higher accuracy on the ImageCLEFF dataset than methods in the state-of-the-art that source additional training examples.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the performance of image classification methods for medical images.
improving the performance of CNNs for medical image classification by developing an ensemble of fine-tuning strategies that are tailored for medical images.
the development of an ensemble of CNN-based classifiers for the automatic classification of medical images into their modalities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method achieves the highest reported performance on this task, without the need for additional data.
our method achieves a state-of-the art accuracy for classifying medical imaging modalities.
we are the first group to show that the ensemble of fine-tuning CNN on natural images can outperform the existing state of the art methods on the medical image classification task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an ensemble of fine-tuning CNN architectures for medical image classification.
the use of a fine-tuned ensemble CNN is an efficient way to classify medical images and can achieve high accuracy with limited training data.
our ensemble of CNNs achieves a state-of-the art performance on ImageCLEF medical image classification task.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fine-tuned CNN features are a powerful tool for classifying medical image modalities and an ensemble of CNN features is a viable approach to improve performance.
an ensemble of fine-tuning different CNN architectures can be used to improve medical image classification accuracy.
the fine-tuned CNN ensemble approach can achieve high classification accuracy for medical image modality classification.
